# WaryBot vs OBot — OUTCOME (C, D), but census is OPEN_BLOCKED

## VERDICT: open_blocked (submitted attempt 2)
Outcome is semantically DETERMINED as (C, D) at large k:
- OBot plays D vs WaryBot k at large k (`Nat.log2 k + 14 ≤ k`): PROVED as
  `wob_obot_plays_D_large` (outer probe WaryBot vs .bot CB → C via search_f;
  inner probe WaryBot vs .bot DB → D via atomNeg; OBot takes inner-else → D).
- WaryBot plays C: guard `.neg(.plays OBot (WaryBot k) .C)` is TRUE (OBot plays D)
  but UNPROVABLE, so WaryBot falls to trusting else → C.

## The WALL (why census fails — recursively-closed avoid-set)
Guard = `.neg (.plays OBot (WaryBot k) .C)`. Need `¬ Pf k` of it.
- OBot is ITE-HEADED. `wv_sound_upto` (the WV kernel) CANNOT force an ite-headed
  player's cooperation atom: its `h_ite` obligation requires FALSE for any ite in S∪S',
  so OBot can't be in S. Confirmed structural limitation. (WV works for MirrorBot/self
  because those are .sim-headed.)
- The `.plays`-target floor kernels (no_provable_probeFirst_tail, searcherPlay_tail,
  tailTo_unreadable, tailToS_floor) all target `.plays` atoms, NOT `.neg` guards.
- A hand-rolled Pf.induct census with a custom valuation VOB forcing OBot's atom true
  IS mathematically sound (atom arm uses AtomProvable_sound; atomNeg forced case uses
  wob_no_D_tail bounded K≤k) BUT the verdict gate REFUSES hand-rolled Pf.induct
  ("hand-rolled census break on future constructors"). So this route is BANNED.
- Even the TailTo census over T=neg fails at CONTRAPOSE: contrapose builds
  `.impl (.neg ψ')(.neg(plays OBot..C))` (TailTo-T-tailed) from `.impl (plays OBot..C) ψ'`
  whose antecedent (plays OBot..C) is UNPROVABLE so IH doesn't fire; closing it needs a
  recursively-closed avoid-set over negation-flip + modal tier (axKf) — the documented wall.
- WaryBot/Helpers.lean's OWN comment lists OBot as OPEN: "OBot (needs ¬Pf of a TRUE
  probe formula — a floor census for .neg spines)".

## PROVEN pieces (compile clean, in case a future kernel appears):
- wob_obot_plays_D_large (OBot plays D at large k) — DONE
- wob_botCB_plays_C_vs_wary (play 2 (.bot CB) (WaryBot k) = C) — DONE
- wob_no_D_tail (∀ K≤k, no TailTo(plays OBot (WaryBot k) D) provable) via
  no_provable_probeFirst_tail with z=CB, p=inner ite, q=const D, aT=C, aTgt=D,
  g=.neg(plays opp self C), pT=const D, pE=const C. hfalse via ⟨2, wob_botCB...⟩. — DONE

## Double-neg obstruction (why no D-cert at any budget):
OBot's D-play cert needs (outer ite_t) WaryBot cooperates vs .bot CB via search_f,
needing `Pf m (.neg (.neg (plays (.bot CB)(WaryBot k) C)))` — a DOUBLE NEG. No rule
produces bare double-neg (atomNeg→single neg of plays; contrapose→impl; negElim→vacuous).
So proving the guard would need a D-cert that doesn't exist at ANY budget, but the
metatheorem "no D-cert at any budget" is itself the same avoid-set census.

## If retried: is there a NEW kernel? Would need a `.neg`-spine floor kernel for
ite-headed inner players. Does not exist. Constructor proposal NOT applicable
(no provable-formula rule can force a NEGATIVE metatheorem). → open_blocked is correct.

Before submitting `open_blocked`, let me reconsider one more time whether the `no_provable_tailTo_unreadable` kernel could give me the budget-free "no D-cert at any budget" — because if I had that, THEN the double-neg census... no, that doesn't help the guard census either.

Actually, let me reconsider whether the guard census could go through `no_provable_tailTo_unreadable` reformulated. The kernel proves `¬ TailTo (.plays P O A) φ` for provable φ. My guard is `.neg(plays OBot..C)` which is NOT TailTo-plays-tailed (it's a neg). So a proof of the guard is a proof of `φ = .neg(plays OBot..C)`. Is this φ ever `TailTo (plays OBot (WaryBot k) C) ψ`? No, φ is `.neg`, TailTo requires `.neg φ' = target plays` — impossible (neg ≠ plays). So the kernel says nothing about neg formulas.

Confirmed. There is no sanctioned kernel for this. Let me submit `open_blocked`.
